adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the DB is mutated first via `prisma.booking.update({ data: { attendees: { createMany: ... }}})` and only afterwards the code calls `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` with no `try/catch` or compensation. If that calendar sync throws, the mutation will error out to the client but the guests have already been persisted. On retry, the handler computes `uniqueGuests` by filtering out emails already present in `booking.attendees`; since the guests are now in the DB, `uniqueGuests.length` can become 0 and the code throws `BAD_REQUEST` with message `emails_must_be_unique_valid`, which is misleading and blocks retry while leaving calendar/email side-effects incomplete.
